budget_provenance.disclosure_boundary: The official benchmark says held-out sample counts and aggregation parameters are not public. This contract governs a reproducible local reference run, not an organizer-certified held-out evaluation.

allowed_transport_only_changes: HTTP server URL and timeout are added
experiment name identifies HTTP full-budget run
smoke_test_rule: Resource feasibility may use an explicitly labeled max_steps=1 diagnostic override; no such checkpoint is a formal Track2 result.
formal_rule: The local reference checkpoint must come from the unoverridden public full-reference configuration and must not be represented as an organizer-certified result.
prohibited: participant MPC or candidate action selection
policy behavior cloning from participant synthetic data
changes to Pi0.5, official reward checkpoint, GRPO algorithm, or formal sample budget
